page.title: Frequency Calculator
page.description: Convert between LTE EARFCN or 5G NR-ARFCN, frequency and band, in the browser. The serving carriers are one click away.

calculator.title: Channel calculator
calculator.description: An EARFCN or NR-ARFCN to its frequency and bands, or a frequency to its channel numbers.
calculator.footnote: LTE: 3GPP TS 36.101 §5.7.3, 100 kHz raster. NR: TS 38.104 §5.4.2.1 global raster, one NR-ARFCN numbering for downlink and uplink. Where bands overlap every candidate is listed; the serving one is marked.

errors.enter_channel: Enter an EARFCN or an NR-ARFCN.
errors.channel_not_integer: A channel number is a whole number, 0 or more.
errors.no_band_any: No LTE or NR band uses channel {{value}}.
errors.frequency_invalid: Enter a frequency in MHz, for example 1842.5.
errors.no_band_frequency_any: No LTE or NR band covers {{value}} MHz.

serving.title: Serving carriers
serving.description: Centre frequencies of every carrier in use, from the live radio data. Each spans half its bandwidth either side.
serving.empty_no_cell: The carriers appear while the modem is attached.
serving.empty_no_data: The carriers appear once diag_bridge or system_bridge sends radio data.
